title: Subtree K-th Max
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 10^5; 0\leq X_i\leq 10^9; 1\leq A_i,B_i\leq N; 1\leq Q \leq 10^5; 1\leq V_i\leq N; 1\leq K_i\leq 20; The given graph is a tree.; The subtree rooted at Vertex V_i has K_i or more vertices.; All values in input are integers.
